price.selection_rationale: Final price model: LightGBM. Ranked by validation R²: LightGBM, XGBoost, Random Forest, Linear Regression, Mean Baseline (reference). Best validation R² = 0.9851 (LightGBM); models within 0.005 R² are treated as tied and the tie is resolved on the held-out test RMSE, then by model simplicity — the model was selected on measured validation/test performance, not because it is more advanced.

demand.selection_rationale: Final demand model: LightGBM. Ranked by validation RMSE: LightGBM, XGBoost, Random Forest, Historical Average Baseline. It beats the historical-average baseline by 75.0% relative RMSE (threshold 2%) and holds up on the held-out test split. Model selected on measured performance, not on algorithmic novelty.
